q:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.

A. An environmental group performed a necropsy on the animal and found about 40 kilograms of plastic, including grocery bags and rice sacks.

B. A 4.7-metre long whale died on Saturday in Phillipines where it was stranded a day earlier.

C. "It' s very disgusting and heartbreaking," he said. "We've done necropsies on 61 dolphins and whales in the last 10 years and this is one of the biggest amounts of plastic we've seen."

D . "The animal died from starvation and was unable to eat because of the trash ﬁlling its stomach," said Darrell Blatchley, Director of D' Bone Collector Museum Inc..
solution:
The correct answer is 'BADC'.

Key Points

• The logical order of the sentences is to start with the event of the whale's death after it was stranded a day earlier. This event is mentioned in sentence B.

• Sentence A provides explicit detail about why the whale died (as a result of 40 kilograms of plastic in its stomach) and this directly links to the ending of sentence B.

• Sentence D introduces Darrell Blatchley, who explains the cause of the animal's death, providing a summary of and commentary on the information in sentence A.

• Sentence C presents further commentary by Blatchley, adding context to the extent of the issue by comparing this case to other instances of plastic found during necropsies.

Therefore, the correct order is 'Option 2'.

Additional Information

• The other options do not provide a logically coherent and chronologically sensible sequence of events based on the content of the sentences.

• The given sentence is an example of a Sentence Jumble.

• The first statement of a sentence jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, the starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.

• Part D will be the first sentence because it is talking about a past happening. It is talking about how the incident began.

• Part A will be the second sentence because it has 'but'. You use but to introduce something which contrasts with what you have just said, or to introduce something which adds to what you have just said. This statement mentions contrary part of what has been mentioned in D

• Part C will be the next in sequence. It explains how Jessica felt on being ignored.

• Part B will be the next sentence because it mentions what Jessica finally did on being left alone.

Thus, the sentences will be arranged as: *When the bell rang for lunch, Jessica took her lunch box and started moving towards the library. But the rest of the students were rushing past her for a break, like she didn't exist. And today, Jessica really felt like maybe she didn't exist. She slowly pushed open the library door and took a seat at one of the tables in the corner.*

A. Our amusements have little zest if we engage in them in solitude.

B. Friendship increases happiness and diminishes misery.

C. It doubles our joys and divides our grief.

D. When we do well, it is delightful to have friends who are pleased with our success.
solution:
The correct answer is 'BCDA'.

Key Points

• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.

• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.

• Sentence B will be the first sentence because it is a general independent statement among the given statements.

• After it, Sentence C will be used because it is connected with the previous sentence. Further tells us what friendship gives us.

• Sentence D will be the next sentence because it tells us how friends are with us when we are successful.

• Lastly, Sentence A will be used.

• Thus, the correct sequence is:

• B: Friendship increases happiness and diminishes misery.

• C: It doubles our joys and divides our grief.

• D: When we do well, it is delightful to have friends who are pleased with our success.

• A: Our amusements have little zest if we engage in them in solitude.

Correct Sequence: *Friendship increases happiness and diminishes misery. It doubles our joys and divides our grief. When we do well, it is delightful to have friends who are pleased with our success. Our amusements have little zest if we engage in them in solitude.*

solution:
The correct answer is option 2.

Key Points

• Let's see the meaning and grammatical structure of each sentence to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

• Overall all given four sentences are talking about Amir

• We need to find an opening statement among these four sentences.

• "Option A is starting with But" which is used to show the contrast situation.

• It simply means that "Sentence A" can not be an opening statement.

• In sentence B "Him" is used. "Him" is a pronoun (Possessive Adjective Case) that is used instead of a Noun.

• It simply means that there should be a Noun before Sentence B, with the help of this we can eliminate options.

• Sentence C starts with "At last"

• The sentence which starts with at last can not be an opening statement based on meaning.

• As "Sentence A, Sentence B, Sentence C' are not the opening statement. Statement D is the opening Statement

• In the sentence D There is a noun named "Amir".

• We use pronouns to avoid repetition of Noun

• In sentence D

• Preparations were made

• In Sentence C

• He arrived at the Beautiful city.

• In Sentence B

• The host welcomed him(Used for Amir)

• Generally, Hosts are requested to rest but here it is showing that contrast so option A is the last sentence.

• So the correct meaningful and coherent Sequence is DCBA

So the correct passage is-* D. Great preparations were made for Amir of Isfahan’s journey to Shiraz. C. At last, he arrived at the beautiful city. B. The host welcomed him warmly. A. But instead of asking the guest to rest, he said, “I have arranged to take you for Shikar.”*

• C) The sentence "The increased amount of carbon emission is considered as the reason behind global warming" provides the cause for global warming, which is due to the increased amount of carbon emission in the atmosphere.

• D) The sentence "The increase in the global temperature is melting the polar ice caps" explains how the increase in global temperature is causing the polar ice caps to melt.

• B) The sentence "The melting of the ice caps will increase the sea level, thereby drowning many islands and coastal regions" explains the consequences of the polar ice caps melting, which will lead to an increase in sea level, causing the drowning of many islands and coastal regions.
